title: Paid Freight Appointments the Carrier Did Not Keep: Booking Fee Treatment (Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders)
content:
**Service recovery rule - Large Item Freight Delivery, Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

A paid appointment the carrier did not keep is one of the redelivery fees charged on the order beyond the failed delivery attempts on record past the method's included delivery attempts before return, its booked date (the order's promised date) having passed. Their number is the count of redelivery fees charged on the order, less the failed delivery attempts on record beyond the included attempts, less one more while the order's promised date is today or later, and never below zero.

For the effective booking fee of a rebooked freight redelivery:

| Freight fee carries a service-failure refund | Paid appointments not kept | Effective booking fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Two or more | Nothing: the booking fee is waived and, of the booking fee and the crew surcharge, only the crew surcharge is charged |
| Yes | Exactly one | The booking fee less the redelivery fee charged for that appointment (the latest redelivery fee on the order), never below zero |
| No | any | The booking fee is not reduced under this rule |
| Yes | None | The booking fee is not reduced under this rule |

**Carries a service-failure refund.** The freight fee carries a service-failure refund when the order history holds fee refunds of kind freight on the order totalling more than zero.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical booking fee of $60.00, one appointment not kept, latest redelivery fee $49.00, freight fee carrying a service-failure refund: effective booking fee $11.00.
- Same, but the latest redelivery fee was $65.00: effective booking fee $0.00 (never below zero).
- Two appointments not kept and a service-failure refund on the freight fee: effective booking fee nothing.
- One appointment not kept but no fee refund of kind freight on the order: the booking fee stands unreduced.

### Counting the appointments (hypothetical order)

An order whose method includes 2 attempts shows 2 failed attempts on record, 3 redelivery fees charged, and a promised date that passed last week: 3 less 0 less 0 gives 3 appointments not kept. Had the promised date been tomorrow, the count would be 2.
